name: Per-core licences; see notes
content:
libvgm - licence

The libvgm repository states no licence of its own: there is no LICENSE or
COPYING file in it. Exilum Player carries it pending the author's permission;
see renderer/src/main/cpp/libvgm/ANDROID-NOTES.md in the source.

The sound cores inside libvgm carry their own licences, in their headers:

- BSD-3-Clause: most of the cores taken from MAME, and ymfm by Aaron Giles.
- LGPL-2.1-or-later: the Nuked OPM and OPL3 cores.
- GPL-2.0-or-later: fmopn.c, fmopl.c, ym2151.c, ym2413.c, ymf262.c,
  nes_apu.c, msm5232.c and nukedopll.c.
- MIT: two further cores.

ymf278b.c (the OPL4) is GPL-2.0 only, which a GPL-3.0 program cannot include,
and is left out of the build.
